---
title: "Publications"
---

<!-- Machinery. Edit _content/publications.yml and
     _content/presentations.yml instead of this file. -->

```{r}
#| include: false
source("_helpers.R")
cfg   <- read_data("settings.yml")$publications
pres  <- read_data("presentations.yml")
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
emit(cfg$intro)
pubs_block(highlight = unlist(cfg$highlight %||% character()))

if (length(pres$posters)) {
  rule()
  eyebrow("Posters")
  listing_block(pres$posters)
}

if (length(pres$talks)) {
  rule()
  eyebrow("Invited talks")
  listing_block(pres$talks)
}
```
